characters.name: The Oldest Son
characters.description: The oldest son is a young man with a nervous demeanor, as depicted when he encounters the large troll. He is perhaps in his early twenties with tousled blond hair and a thin build. Dressed in simple, rustic clothing typical of a farmer's son, he wears a light brown tunic over dark trousers. His shoes are worn, showing signs of working the land. His expression is one of fear and hesitation when the troll menacingly points towards the forest, emphasizing his reluctance to face danger.

characters.name: The Father
characters.description: The father is an elderly man wearing plain, but neat attire appropriate for a farmer. His hair is graying, and he has a well-weathered face marked by years of outdoor labor. He stands at home, holding a clenched fist slightly raised as he discusses the cowardice of his sons. With furrowed brows and a stern expression, he shows his frustration with them for not standing up to the troll as he claims he would have in his youth.

characters.name: Askeladden
characters.description: Askeladden is the youngest son, appearing younger than his brothers, likely in his late teens. He has a clever and resourceful nature, which is evident when he stands confidently with a cheese in hand, pretending to squeeze water from it as a means to threaten the troll. He wears a simple forest green tunic with a belt, and his leather pouch is slung around his shoulder. Askeladden's eyes glint with mischief, and his posture exudes self-assuredness, marking him as brave yet cunning.

characters.name: The Troll
characters.description: The troll is a large and menacing creature with rugged, rocky skin and a hulking silhouette. Its features are exaggeratedly monstrous, with long, scraggly hair and sharp, protruding teeth. Clad in tattered, earth-toned rags, it towers over the oldest son, brandishing a thick finger threateningly towards him. Despite its fearsome appearance, the troll is not very bright, as it is later deceived by Askeladden's cunning.
